notes.text: A South African Africanfuturist heist game released on 10 February 2026. Players plan museum break-ins to reclaim real African artefacts from Western collections. The game turns the procedural language of restitution into a counter-heist fantasy while presenting researched object histories. It is registered as a creative source, not as evidence that its fictional treaty, institutions or recoveries occurred. Its represented artefacts have not been reconciled with MoSA object records, and no promotional media is republished.
